claims.statement: The European Commission recommendation on online gambling calls for operator policies that enable interaction when player behavior indicates risk and for controls including limits, alerts, time-out, and self-exclusion.
Polish gambling law requires licensed online operators to implement responsible-gaming rules and sets requirements around player registration, age checks, information, and data archiving.

contrary_evidence: Large operators and platform vendors often maintain in-house safer-gambling models.
Operator incentives may conflict with interventions that reduce short-term wagering.

economics.acquisition_route: Build a replayable synthetic-data demonstration, then secure a paid sandbox with one licensed operator through a platform or compliance consultant; no live intervention before approval.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 30 EU operators at 25000 PLN monthly net revenue produce 9m PLN ARR; at 30% EBITDA, 4x EBITDA, and 60% founder ownership, equity is about 6.5m PLN in year 6-9, without double-counting retained cash.
economics.founder_time: Hypothesis: 12-18 hours weekly, with jurisdictional counsel and an independent safer-gambling specialist paid per deployment.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 72-82% after streaming infrastructure, model monitoring, audit support, and reseller share.
economics.payback: Hypothesis: 30000-70000 PLN integration and assurance cost per operator, recovered in 4-8 contracted months.
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 12000-30000 PLN per operator monthly plus event-volume tiers, with a 15-25% reseller share.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Compliance operation is continuous and event-based; annual contracts renew if auditability and outcome metrics remain credible.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Jurisdiction-specific intervention outcomes and calibrated behavioral sequences improve policy effectiveness
fingerprint.customer: Licensed online betting and gambling operators using a shared platform or payment stack
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Gaming-platform vendors, aggregators, or payment providers resell the engine to their operator base
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Configurable risk detection, intervention orchestration, and effectiveness reporting SaaS
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Operator pays a recurring license and usage fee for scored events and auditable interventions
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A player's time, deposits, losses, behavior changes, or failed controls cross an operator-defined harm threshold

founder_fit: The founder understands gambling behavior personally while data science supports event-level risk models.
The mission converts domain interest into harm reduction rather than gambling promotion.
Platform-led distribution concentrates sales and avoids a public gambling persona.
risks: False negatives expose players and customers to harm; false positives can unfairly restrict users.
Behavioral and payment data require strict privacy and security controls.
Regulatory rules and acceptable interventions vary by jurisdiction.

structure.control_point: Auditable mapping from behavioral risk signal to approved intervention and measured outcome
structure.critical_dependency: Licensed operator event access and credible validation that interventions reduce harm

thesis: Sell licensed betting platforms a configurable event-stream service that detects emerging harm indicators, selects a proportionate intervention from operator-approved policy, records what happened, and measures whether risk declined. A platform provider or payments processor can resell it across operators. The company supplies compliance and harm-reduction infrastructure only; it never operates gambling, markets bets, or optimizes player spend.
title: Responsible-Gambling Intervention Engine
uncertainties: Which smaller regulated operators lack adequate event-level intervention tooling?
Can effectiveness be measured without access to sensitive financial or clinical data?
Will a platform provider resell a third-party policy engine across jurisdictions?
